events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, and the US has shown its military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power. The conflict has revealed the limits of US power and the UK's geopolitical standing and military readiness.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war will lead to increased demand for defense equipment and services, benefiting the aerospace and defense sector. On the other hand, the conflict will disrupt oil supplies, negatively impacting the oil services sector.

timeFrame.note: Monitor the conflict's progression and adjust accordingly
